description: This file defines the main engine configuration data structure, related macros, function prototypes for engine configuration management, and includes external headers. It is used for configuring engine parameters and settings in an embedded system.

methods.name: getRpmMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the RPM multiplier based on the operation mode.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the engine operation mode in the configuration.

methods.name: prepareVoidConfiguration
methods.description: Prepares an empty or default engine configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the default engine configuration parameters.

methods.name: setWholeIgnitionIatCorr
methods.description: Sets the ignition IAT correction table.

methods.name: setWholeIatCorrTimingTable
methods.description: Sets the entire IAT correction timing table.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable_d
methods.description: Sets the entire timing table with a double precision value.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable
methods.description: Macro to set the whole timing table.

methods.name: printFloatArray
methods.description: Prints a float array with a prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Returns the current global configuration version.

methods.name: commonFrankensoAnalogInputs
methods.description: Configures common analog inputs for Frankenso.
